title: Sages of the Nations
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in Pesachim 94b regarding the sun's course, where Rabbi said, “Their account seems more convincing than ours.” In Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:1 they say that a son and daughter are equal regarding inheritance; this is also related in Shabbat 116b.

notes.text: The source’s compressed ומבוא is read contextually as an explanatory cross-reference to Shabbat, not a separate named item. Rabbi’s comparison is quoted as Hyman gives it.

Rabbi’s qualified preference concerns the solar path. Yerushalmi Bava Batra attributes the inheritance position to the sages of the nations. Shabbat 116b puts the parallel claim in the dialogue of a staged dispute.
